headlines.description: — Matas Buzelis scored 28 points to lead nine Chicago players in double figures and the Bulls outlasted the Atlanta Hawks 152-150 on Sunday in the highest-scoring game in the NBA this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bulls beat the Hawks 152-150 in the highest-scoring game in the NBA this season

headlines.description: — Michael Porter Jr. scored 24 points, Noah Clowney added 19 and Brooklyn Nets beat the Toronto Raptors 96-81 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porter and Clowney lead the Nets to a 96-81 victory over the Raptors

events.name: Miami Heat at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson scored a season-high 47 points and the New York Knicks overcame Karl-Anthony Towns’ quiet night to beat the Miami Heat 132-125 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores season-high 47 points, Knicks overcome Towns’ quiet night to beat the Heat

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Washington Wizards

headlines.description: — De’Aaron Fox scored 27 points and sank five 3-pointers to help the San Antonio Spurs ease to a 124-113 victory over the Washington Wizards on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fox scores 27, leads Spurs to 124-113 win over Wizards

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 24 points despite a poor night shooting and the Minnesota Timberwolves rode timely 3-pointers from Donte DiVincenzo and Terrence Shannon Jr. to a 103-100 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards scores 24 as Wolves outlast Bucks 103-100 for their 9th win in 11 games

headlines.description: — Dennis Schroder made a 3-pointer with 2.2 seconds remaining in overtime, lifting the Sacramento Kings to a 125-124 victory over the Houston Rockets on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schroeder hits late 3 in OT as Kings stun Rockets 125-124
